svg.title: CORTEX hybrid scheduler dataflow
svg.desc: Observation feeds a rule-based doctrine and an ML utility model; a candidate mask combines them to pick a band; rules choose dwell
svg.text: Rules control the doctrine · ML controls the decisions within that doctrine
band tracks · receiver state · rolling dwell history
rule engine · what kind of behaviour is appropriate
• Selects mode: explore / investigate / track / relocate
LSTM / GRU · predicts a utility for each of 128 bands
rules remove invalid bands · highest-utility valid band wins
